review_contract.originals_only: Actually view every listed original candidate and related original reference. No old images or verdicts, no contact-sheet substitution, and no mechanical-PASS visual inference.
review_contract.local_only: Local static text reads and tools.view_image only. No local or remote application/test/build/probe/validation, no SSH, copying or image processing, no production/harness/plan edits.
review_contract.scale: Exact native captures use logical dimensions and original references physical dimensions at factor two. Read each case actual native_capture_size/physical_reference_scale; keep native dimensions.
review_contract.closed_reader: Artwork only; no persistent footer, bookmark ribbon, page/status label or download notice. Open menus follow the frozen export.
review_contract.data: Titles/covers/counts/dates may differ as actual data; geometry, typography, outlines, clipping, navigation allocation and interaction affordances cannot be waived.
review_contract.report: English JSON; concrete observations and exact original evidence/state/reference SHA per case. Separate static appearance from captured replay/state support. No full-round/clean acceptance claim.
review_contract.readability: If an original cannot be read at the available view size, report the exact needed original crop and keep the affected check pending. Do not generate crops locally or lower the threshold.
